subject: Taxes
title: Where Your Tax Money Goes
description: A 60-second lesson on Where Your Tax Money Goes.

hook.text: Every dollar of US federal income tax splits roughly: 25 cents to Social Security, 25 cents to healthcare.

buildup.text: Social Security and Medicare are the largest federal expenses.

discovery.text: Interest on the national debt consumes about 10 cents of every tax dollar—and rising.

twist.text: Education, infrastructure, and science combined receive less than 5% of federal spending.

climax.text: Understanding where taxes go changes how people feel about paying them. Transparency builds trust.

punchline.text: Half to the elderly, a quarter to defense. That's your tax dollar.

quiz.question: What consumes the largest share of US federal tax dollars?
